title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_zh: 实现偏好驱动的去学习：面向少步蒸馏文本到图像扩散模型

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种基于偏好驱动的卸载框架，旨在改进少数步骤蒸馏文本到图像扩散模型的卸载效果。 Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种基于偏好驱动的卸载框架，旨在改进少数步骤蒸馏文本到图像扩散模型的卸载效果。文本到图像扩散模型正越来越多地被蒸馏为少数步骤变体，并部署以实现快速推理。 然而，它们生成有害或不期望内容的能力带来了显著的安全风险。 数据驱动的去学习方法通过利用专门的去学习目标对模型权重进行微调，从而抑制目标生成的内容。 关键在于，这些目标隐式地依赖于多步骤去噪动态，而这一假设在少数步骤蒸馏（FSD）模型中并不成立，导致去学习效果不佳。 此外，在非蒸馏基础模型上执行去学习，然后重新蒸馏以获得一个经过去学习的 FSD 模型，会产生巨大的计算和时间开销，使其在许多场景下难以实施。 因此，我们通过一种基于偏好的去学习框架来解决这一局限性，该框架重新审视了扩散模型的直接偏好优化（DPO）方法。 我们发现，标准 DPO 及其围绕噪声预测误差构建的去学习衍生方法，由于其生成动态的改变，难以有效迁移到 FSD 模型中。 为克服这一问题，我们引入了一种修改后的偏好优化公式，该公式明确与少数步骤生成的特性对齐，从而能够在 FSD 模型中直接移除特定概念，同时保持少数步骤的高效性，并维持对期望（非目标）能力的强保留能力。 我们主要在身份识别和 NSFW（裸露内容）移除任务上评估了我们的框架，并将该方法扩展到了物体级别的去学习。 广泛的实验表明，我们的方法能够一致且有效地实现去学习，并表现出强大的能力保留性能，确立了其作为 FSD 模型中卸载任务的实用且基于原理的解决方案。
